response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cs.constructorId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorStandings cs GROUP BY cs.constructorId) SELECT c.constructorId, k.nationality, c.cnt AS standings_count, c.cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg FROM c JOIN constructors k ON k.constructorId = c.constructorId ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is taken over constructors that have at least one standings record (constructors with zero records are excluded from the average).
Each row in constructorStandings counts as one standings record (one per race per constructor).

alternatives.interpretation: Average over all constructors in the constructors table, counting those with no standings records as 0.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT k.constructorId, k.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS cnt FROM constructors k LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = k.constructorId GROUP BY k.constructorId, k.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, cnt AS standings_count, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg FROM c ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
